description: PySAM, published by NatLabRockies, wraps SAM's technology and financial models in Python modules with explicit inputs, outputs, error checks and default-parameter support. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The README limits interpreter and operating-system compatibility; it is a wrapper, not a new physical model. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: model-system-advisor-model-sam records the desktop program and compute models. PySAM is the separately distributed Python wrapper with its own package and compatibility requirements.
